# Ntombis Fashion

> Ntombis Fashion is a custom clothing studio in Rustenburg, North West, South Africa. It designs and makes tailor-made garments around each client's story, body, culture and occasion: wedding attire, matric dance dresses, traditional wear, tailor-made suits, event dresses and coordinated his & hers sets.

## Key facts
- Official name: Ntombis Fashion (also written NTOMBIS FASHION and Ntombis Custom Clothing)
- Address: 121 President Mbeki Drive, Rustenburg, North West, 0299, South Africa
- Phone and WhatsApp: +27 72 340 0477 (072 340 0477)
- Email: info@ntombis.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–14:00, Sunday closed
- How to enquire: WhatsApp (https://wa.me/27723400477), phone, email, or the form at https://www.ntombis.com/contact
- Everything is made to order; there is no ready-to-wear stock yet.
